title: Geometry-Aware Multi-Objective Optimization: Norm-Constrained Oracles with Entropic Weight Updates
abstract: arXiv:2610.13773v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multiple-gradient descent is typically formulated in Euclidean geometry, whereas matrix-aware optimizers use directions induced by other norms. We analyze a single-loop multi-objective method combining a norm-constrained linear minimization oracle with entropic updates of task weights. For any finite-dimensional norm pair, we establish an $O(T^{-1/2})$ ergodic stationarity rate in the deterministic setting, deriving the required trajectory gradient bound from smoothness and lower-boundedness in the unregularized case. With stochastic gradients and a bounded-gradient assumption, one persistent blended-gradient momentum buffer yields an $O(T^{-1/4})$ rate whose leading term has no explicit dependence on the number of tasks. translated_title: 几何感知的多目标优化：范数约束预言机与熵权重更新
translated_abstract: 多梯度下降通常在欧几里得几何中进行表述，而矩阵感知的优化器则使用由其他范数诱导的方向。我们分析了一种单循环多目标方法，该方法将范数约束的线性最小化预言机与任务权重的熵更新相结合。对于任意有限维范数对，我们在确定性设定下建立了 $O(T^{-1/2})$ 的遍历平稳性速率，并在未正则化的情形下从光滑性与下有界性推导出所需的轨迹梯度界。在随机梯度与有界梯度假设下，仅需一个持久的混合梯度动量缓冲区即可获得 $O(T^{-1/4})$ 的速率，其主项对任务数量没有显式依赖。我们还对内层加权目标在任意有界梯度序列上建立了静态遗憾界，并且在引入熵正则化和权重下限后，可在预热阶段之后实现逐迭代的内层间隙控制，同时保持……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种将范数约束线性最小化预言机与任务权重熵更新相结合的单循环多目标优化方法，对任意有限维范数对实现了确定性 $O(T^{-1/2})$ 与随机 $O(T^{-1/4})$ 的遍历平稳性速率，且随机情形的主项与任务数量无关。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a single-loop multi-objective optimization method combining a norm-constrained linear minimization oracle with entropic task-weight updates, achieving $O(T^{-1/2})$ deterministic and $O(T^{-1/4})$ stochastic ergodic stationarity rates for any finite-dimensional norm pair, with the stochastic leading term independent of the number of tasks.
